verdict.rationale: No evidence describes an export feature that preserves comments, attachments, or audit trails; docs focus on API access to pages/comments but not on a workspace export capability with full history preservation, and community threads even flag difficulty 'getting stuff out of' Notion. Missing for 10: documentation of export formats (HTML/Markdown/PDF/CSV), confirmation that comments/attachments/audit trails are included in exports, and any hands-on verification of export fidelity.
